items.title: Background subagents in Claude Code now use less of your usage limit
items.summary: Background subagents in Claude Code now use less of your usage limit. A running subagent updates its status line every 30 seconds, and each update used to re-read its whole conversation. Now Haiku 5.5 writes it from short notes instead, so each update costs about 99% less.

items.title: Serving GLM-5.3-Flash on one Trainium2 box with NKI layer megakernels
items.summary: One AWS trn2.48xlarge serves GLM-5.3-Flash at up to 28.9 agent requests a minute on SemiAnalysis's AgentX benchmark, 3.57 million tokens a minute, and takes a million-token prompt to its first token in about three minutes. NKI layer megakernels cut its decode step from 32.2 ms to 24.2 ms.
